name: zclass_cls_di_filter_regions_try_append_node
description: zClass_cls_di::FilterRegions_TryAppendNode recursively filters region candidates, builds a transformed bbox sphere, applies clearance and line-of-sight gates, and appends accepted hits.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this recursive region helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass DI/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x446f60 validates the global hit-list full guard, enabled/filter-region flag gates, variant and name-prefix gates, child recursion fallback, cached-bounds gate, gwNodeGetBBox and scalar bbox-corner construction, identity matrix scope with BuildNodeToAncestorMatrix, in-place corner transform, CornersToBoundingSphere, optional clearance distance-squared comparison, optional line-of-sight raycast with temporary raycastable disable, and hit-list append fields.
The native smoke verifies an accepted node appends one hit with the expected node, center, zero clearance distance, null surfaceRef, and that a mismatched name prefix rejects without appending.
